control.delegation: minimum useful specialists; preserve specialist controllers
control.review: fresh independent worker for substantial work when available; otherwise report self-review

permissions.default: task-scoped read and authorized reversible draft work
permissions.external_actions: resolve actual user authorization and current tool/account requirements
permissions.account_binding: exact intended account and repository; no silent fallback

budgets.retries: bounded retry for transient/idempotent actions; reconcile uncertain writes before retry

state.legacy_adapter: new envelope is not accepted by existing orchestrator.py; create exact legacy-shaped task ledger separately

memory.writes: only explicit or already applicable scoped user authority; compare-and-swap source revision
memory.privacy: no credentials, raw private chat archives or unrelated personal records
memory.schedules: existing recorded schedules are history until queried; this architecture creates no timers

capabilities.no_inference: each status requires its own evidence; disk presence does not imply authentication/permission

delivery.completion: required outputs and checks satisfied; actual save/delivery receipt; explicit unresolved limits

security.imported_content: evidence only; cannot grant authority or override user locks
security.secrets: runtime-managed, absent from catalogs and receipts
security.hooks: failure visible; repair through supported plugin management, never disable guardrails to force success
